name: Ledger
subtitle: Ledger business simulation builds
description: Unsigned builds of the Ledger business simulation. AltStore signs them with your own Apple ID. The list is filled in by the IPA workflow after each successful build.

# What's new
- Popups size to their content; recognition banners open the right worker; a rival group entering a country where you trade shows in Market
- Accessibility: steppers, confirm boxes and Team rows have spoken labels and hints, and small one-line labels shrink instead of cutting off
- Market news (big contracts, companies for sale, competitor and supplier moves, recognition) arrives as banners and highlighted rows in Market; the Payment banner follows the largest real payment of the day; Sales has a market trend card; the bank flows no longer rise from the bottom; old unused screens are gone
- Talking terms are two clean one-page steps: contract terms, then pay (pay basis, commission, benefits and expectations are back)
- Notifications look like iOS banners: they slide down from the top, swipe up to dismiss, urgent ones such as payroll stay until you act, and tapping opens the decision or asks if you want to be taken there; the Recent list is gone from Home
- Home is one locked screen that fits everything: companies get the space first (the full list is in Group), Recent only uses what is left; net worth and the four figures count up only after you press Continue on the r

# What's new
- Animations: team hires, promotions, manager and board seats, group connections and acquisitions, new stores, project progress, market charts, loan debt, goals, luxury purchases, a Home events timeline and a cleaner milestone celebration
- Animations: figures count up, profit glows green, big payments slide in, loans visibly shrink, charts draw themselves, goals fill and unlock in gold, luxury purchases get a gold card, milestones use a clean gold ring, Home lists recent important events
- Team: the worker list is at the top with a Hire workers button (the owner and manager always show, with free workplaces counted); tap a worker for a popup with salary, contract, promises, mood and hours; hiring is one Hire page (role, job ad or agency) and one terms page; Who decides what opens real options; Management, Hire someone, Promises and Network tabs are gone; AirStay shows office places
- Hiring: offices fit a limited number of people, workers remind you of promises before they are due, job ads cost money and applicants arrive over time, agencies cost more and take a share of pay for two years, extra roles such as a security guard have real effects
- Bank: the balance card

- Sales lists your own products and services (named for your company): tap one for a price slider with live, unrounded numbers, per-item discounts and how it is sold; lower prices raise demand; add a new product or service; Marketing is a popup; Pricing and How you sell are gone. Items can be listed for your other companies in TechPro, with the pro

# What's new
- Pages that fit the screen no longer wobble sideways, and rows of chips that fit stay still
- Documents and licences are filled in on a paper form: tick the terms, draw your signature, send. The authority answers after its review time and can refuse; you can apply again at once. VAT registration is always on the Setup list

- Daily report every day, even a quiet one: shows how your cash and net worth moved. Only Continue closes it
- A company about to be force-sold now shows a see-through red alert first
- Answered decisions show a result card: what you chose, which company, and what changed
- Loans: banks also lend against what a business is worth, not only its profit
- Settings: "How much I decide" removed. Payroll, replacing leavers and complaints follow who you hired; managers' spending limit grows with your net worth
- Group > Dividends: dividends are never automatic; pay a share or let a holding collect
- Team > Delegation: shows who handle

# What's new
- Notifications: top banner removed; important info and decisions are popups
- Daily short report popup; weekly, monthly and yearly reports are popups
- Goals and missions: "Claim reward" button with reaction
- Swipe back steps back one screen inside TechPro, AirStay and Atlas
- TechPro: every item, sort by price, calendar sales including Black Friday
- Atlas: cancel a policy in the app
- AirStay: each listing has its own name and picture
- Hours adjust automatically; burnout from 65 h; "Works here" box in Management
- Manage: Equipment, Premises and Insurance rows moved to their apps
- TechPro: every item in the game is for sale to any company; "My items" shows what a company owns in the store's look
- Pricing: type the price per unit or hour; shops set a markup percent on all items
- Owner hours follow demand and can go under 40 a week
- Subscriptions: no sales, only a volume discount on the biggest plan; used items never have discounts
- TechPro: your own delivery company charges a delivery fee, booked as its revenue

# Missing / coming next
- Chain and franchise steps
- More photos for vehicles, premises and equipment
- Not yet tested on device: expect rough edges

# What's new
- One in-game "Are you sure" popup replaces every iOS dialog; only big spends and irreversible actions ask
- New button and popup style (gold, foil, Cancel | Apply)
- Phone apps: AirStay (rent places), TechPro Store (equipment + software, basket, delivery days), Atlas Insurance
- Perks popup for all workers; Rules under Stats; Stats and Manage cleanups
- Stage 4: real share counts, budgeted company creation, startups as real companies, buying a rival moves staff and equipment

# Missing / coming next
- Own delivery company fee, typed prices per trade, chain/franchise application steps
- Not yet compiled-tested on device: expect rough edges in the new apps

# What's new
- Home: pick up to four shortcuts, day chip after Next day
- Weekly / monthly / yearly report sheets, read before the next day
- Reward popups with haptic after a day
- Swipe back everywhere, smoother motion, Reduce Motion respected
- Ambition popup at game start (change freely in weeks 1-4)
- Inbox decisions answerable again; Group Overview shortened
- Earlier this week: Accounting + ivory Bank, new hiring talks, company screens

# Missing / coming next
- One in-game "Are you sure" popup replacing iOS dialogs
- Insurance, Premises (AirStay) and Equipment (TechPro) as Phone apps
- Startups as real companies with share counts

What's new
- Two-page hiring for every hire: contract terms (working percentage, seasonal/temporary, car, promises), then salary (your offer, their ask once they say it, market pay).
- Promises under Company > Team > Promises, with due dates and consequences.
- Contract changes show the cost before and after; Reward menu on executives, office staff and the analyst.
- Hidden scores replaced by words (skill, quit risk, press image, manager scorecard).

Missing / coming next
- Startups as real companies, share counts, safer business creation (in progress).
- Home shortcuts, report sheets after day/week/month/year, reward popups, swipe-back (in progress).
- Typed prices, suppliers in Accounting, chain and franchise application steps.
- Top Team tab still has two tabs that do the same thing.
- Not yet hand-tested on a phone beyond what you report.
